create_when_then: create a when-then-otherwise expression that assigns values based on column conditions
build_chained_when: build a chained when-then-otherwise expression with multiple conditions and fallback
test_equality_constraints: test when-then-otherwise using keyword equality constraints like foo=3
summarize_multiple_predicates: summarize when-then-otherwise with multiple predicates combined implicitly via AND
review_when_class: review the When class that represents the initial state of a when-then-otherwise expression
